entries.title: Joshua 21:3
segments: It is not left merely to the inclinations of men whether they will provide for the comfortable support of the ministers of religion, but it is the command of God that those who preach the gospel should live of the gospel, and their hearers cannot withhold from them needful support wihtout depriving them of what is justly their due.

entries.title: Joshua 21:4
segments: Judah--Simeon--Benjamin; thus the priests had their cities in the tribes that were near to Jerusalem and the temple afterwards built there.
It is a great convenience for the ministers of religion to live near the place of public worship, and generally it will be found to be most conducive to their good and the good of the people.

entries.title: Joshua 21:5
segments: The rest; those of the family of Kohath who were not priests.
There should be ministers of religion in all parts of the country, that all the people may have the benefit of their good instructions and example.

entries.title: Joshua 21:27
segments: The children of Gershon; these were Levites, but not priests.

entries.title: Joshua 21:34
segments: The children of Merari; Levites, but not priests.

entries.title: Joshua 21:41
segments: Forty and eight cities; according to the direction of Moses,

. 
 
The Lord in his providence appoints to ministers their various fields of labor, and wherever they are placed it should be their great object to honor him and be most useful to men.

entries.title: Joshua 21:42
segments: Suburbs; adjacent territory to the extent of two thousand cubits on every side, according to the direction in

entries.title: Joshua 21:43
segments: They possessed it; they possessed all that they then needed; and the rest the Lord would give them, according to his promise,

. 
 
Whatever may be the promises of God, and however great the difficulties in the way of their accomplishment, in due time they will all be fulfilled.
